decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GLA-02L, GLA-03L, GLA-04L, , received on 2705/2013 and GLA-05L Rev A, received on 26/06/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, openable only above 1.70m above internal floor level and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to the house
